method: Google Maps main Miller Motorcars place, 342 W Putnam Ave, Greenwich, CT, Reviews sorted Newest. Read 210 loaded reviews through 6 years ago. Also read the separate McLaren Greenwich place at 348 W Putnam Ave, which exists as its own 5.0-star Google place with 51 reviews, including 6 Nick mentions, 5 Anthony Chrystone mentions, and 5 Aleksey Katkov mentions. Main-place counts are per review mention, five_star is 5 stars, last_90d uses the displayed relative date, and negative is 1 or 2 stars. Staff roles and public phone came from the Miller staff page. No forms, messages, calls, likes, replies, or other writes were performed.
